qs.s: Les pays membres ont soutenu un traité mondial de ___ nucléaire.
qs.en: The member states supported a global nuclear disarmament treaty.

qs.s: La conférence de l'ONU sur le ___ a réuni des délégués du monde entier.
qs.en: The UN conference on disarmament brought together delegates from around the world.

qs.s: Les soldats ont procédé au ___ des rebelles capturés.
qs.en: The soldiers carried out the disarming of the captured rebels.

qs.s: Le ___ des milices a été exigé avant toute négociation de paix.
qs.en: The disarming of the militias was required before any peace negotiations.

qs.s: ___ désarmement est un objectif prioritaire pour l'ONU.
qs.en: Disarmament is a priority objective for the UN.

qs.s: Il a parlé d'___ désarmement progressif lors du sommet.
qs.en: He spoke of a gradual disarmament at the summit.

qs.en: He goes to the gym every day to stay in shape.

qs.en: These administrative tasks are accomplished on a daily basis by our team without difficulty.

qs.en: He handles the routine affairs of the office on a daily basis.

qs.s: Il a photographié l'___ baroque des palais de Rome.
qs.en: He photographed the Baroque architecture of Rome's palaces.

qs.en: She decided to study architecture at the École des Beaux-Arts.

qs.en: Architecture is a discipline that combines art and engineering.

qs.s: Ce processeur repose sur une ___ 64 bits très performante.
qs.en: This processor is based on a very powerful 64-bit architecture.

qs.en: The engineers designed a new network architecture to improve security.

qs.en: He admires the architecture of this modern museum.
